39: He may judge, but he is not exempt from payment if he erred — however, if he is gamir and savir, their acceptance of him by order of the king helps to exempt him from payment, according to the view of the Tur, and not like what appears from the words of the Rambam, who wrote that the king's writ does not help at all where he erred, even where they accepted [him] upon themselves — end of the Bach's words. But in my humble opinion nothing appears from the Rambam [to that effect], and the Rambam too concedes to this — see there, analyze this.
